today.desc: High-performance financial trading terminal and charting core for React. Powered by KlineCharts v10, React 19 & Tailwind CSS v4 with zero backend dependencies.
features: - Proprietary iframe widgets: Black-box state, strict branding mandates, limited layout customization, and no direct access to internal drawing coordinate data.

- Low-level canvas libraries: High rendering performance, but requiring manual construction of toolbars, timeframe bars, drawing mechanics, indicators, modals, right-dock panels, and WebSocket data streams.

- Direct exchange connectivity: Connects directly from the browser to public REST and native WebSocket streams (Binance, Bybit, OKX, Bitget) with automatic offline synthetic market generator fallback.
- Unrestricted technical toolset: Complete drawing suite (trend lines, Fibonacci fans, volume profiles, position calculators) accessible without authentication or paywalls.
- Multi-chart workspace synchronization: Built-in WorkspaceProvider and useChartSync coordinating multi-grid layouts with crosshair, scroll, zoom, symbol, and timeframe mirroring.
- Sub-cent precision auto-detection: Automatic decimal detection (detectPricePrecision) preventing sub-cent assets (e.g. PEPE, SHIB @ 0.000005) from collapsing into flat lines or zero-clamped Y-axes.
- Pluggable storage adapter: Seamless state persistence for layout presets, custom indicator parameters, price alerts, and terminal settings.
- Tailwind CSS v4 & Radix UI: Accessible dialogs, popovers, dropdowns, and context menus styled with OKLCH design tokens.
- Native internationalization: Type-safe localization for English (en), Vietnamese (vi), and Simplified Chinese (zh).
today.trDesc: React的高性能金融交易终端和图表核心。由KlineCharts v10、React 19和Tailwind CSS v4提供支持，零后端依赖。
today.trFeat:
-专有的iframe小部件：黑盒状态、严格的品牌要求、有限的布局自定义以及无法直接访问内部绘图坐标数据。
-低级画布库：高渲染性能，但需要手动构建工具栏、时间范围栏、绘图机制、指示器、模态、右停靠面板和WebSocket数据流。 -直接交换连接：从浏览器直接连接到公共REST和原生WebSocket流（币安、Bybit、OKX、Bitget ） ，并具有自动离线合成市场生成器回退。
-不受限制的技术工具集：无需身份验证或付费墙即可访问完整的绘图套件（趋势线、斐波那契风扇、体积曲线、位置计算器）。 -多图表工作区同步：内置WorkspaceProvider和useChartSync ，通过十字线、滚动、缩放、符号和时间范围镜像来协调多网格布局。
-百分位精度自动检测：自动十进制检测（ detectPricePrecision ）可防止百分位资产（例如PEPE、SHIB @ 0.000005 ）折叠成平直线或零夹持的Y轴。 -可插拔存储适配器：布局预设、自定义指标参数、价格提醒和终端设置的无缝状态持久性。
-顺风CSS v4和Radix UI ：使用OKLCH设计令牌设计的可访问对话框、弹出窗口、下拉菜单和上下文菜单。
-母语国际化：英语（ zh ）、越南语（ vi ）和简体中文（ zh ）的类型安全本地化。

week.desc: Run your own Switch games natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac: game code rewritten to ARM64, graphics direct to Metal, one app for the whole library. Bring your own games and keys. 把你自己的 Switch 游戏原生带到 iPhone / iPad / Mac。
features: - Ryujinx (Ryujinx Team and Contributors, MIT): upstream for system services and shader translation; S2Arm's compatibility layer is built on it.
- NX2Apple (LNPANDY, MIT): upstream of the launcher interface.

- nxnative (seedds, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 seedds): the original work behind the direct graphics layer that connects game graphics straight to Metal. That generous release is what made the direct path possible.
- d2r-mobile (MIT): pioneered this technical path, bringing your own Switch game natively to iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and HarmonyOS for the first time.
- Impactor (Samara M, MIT) and apple-codesign (MPL-2.0): signing and installing from Windows.
- LNPANDY and the original authors and contributors of the iOS library shell: the shell and its RomFS archive subsystem.
week.trDesc: 在iPhone、iPad和Mac上本地运行您自己的Switch游戏：游戏代码重写到ARM64 ，图形直接到Metal ，一个应用程序用于整个库。自带游戏和钥匙。把你自己的切换游戏原生带到iPhone/iPad/Mac。
week.trFeat:
- Ryujinx （ Ryujinx团队和贡献者，麻省理工学院） ：系统服务和着色器翻译的上游； S2Arm的兼容层建立在其上。
- NX2Apple (LNPANDY, MIT) ：启动器接口的上游。
- nxnative （ seedds、MIT、Copyright (c) 2026 seedds ） ：直接图形层背后的原创作品，将游戏图形直接连接到Metal。 这种慷慨的释放使直接路径成为可能。 - d2r-mobile （麻省理工学院） ：开创了这条技术之路，首次将您自己的Switch游戏本地带到iPhone、iPad、Mac、Android和HarmonyOS。
- Impactor （ Samara M ， MIT ）和apple-codesign （ MPL-2.0 ） ：从Windows进行签名和安装。
- LNPANDY以及iOS库shell的原始作者和贡献者： shell及其RomFS存档子系统。

week.desc: Monitors your RAM and reports any "quite terrible" unused capacity directly to the CEO of OpenAI.
features: - Tracks total, used and available RAM, plus your standing with the global allocation authorities
- Handles page cache correctly, which already puts it ahead of most arguments about RAM
- Sends at most one email per day, because we're hoarders, not animals
- Rotates 8 subject lines, 10 messages and 6 sign-offs, so the joke gets old at a carefully managed pace
- Logs every sample to CSV for when the auditors arrive
- Ships with 14 tests, more than the DRAM market has had sensible outcomes
- Is written in bash, as an Electron version would have solved the problem by using all the RAM
week.trDesc: 监控您的RAM ，并将任何“相当糟糕”的未使用容量直接报告给OpenAI的首席执行官。
week.trFeat:
-跟踪总计、使用和可用RAM ，以及您在全球分配机构中的地位
-正确处理页面缓存，这已经使其领先于大多数关于RAM的参数
-每天最多发送一封电子邮件，因为我们是囤积者，不是动物
-旋转8个主题行， 10条消息和6个签名，这样笑话就会以精心管理的速度变老
-将每个样本记录到CSV中，以供审核员到达时使用 -已进行14次测试的船舶，超过DRAM市场已取得的明智结果
-是用bash编写的，因为Electron版本可以通过使用所有RAM来解决问题

week.desc: Let AI agents use your phone, with you in the loop.
features: - Tiny and native. The window is drawn by MyGo on the GPU, with no Electron and no webview: a 16–22 MB download that idles at about 70 MB of memory and 0% CPU on a Mac.
- Any agent, one click. Settings › Agents connects Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor and more, and any agent that can use MCP servers works, on the same computer or over HTTP.
- Locked phone? Unlock it from your computer. Save the phone's PIN in Pinky once, then confirm each unlock with Touch ID, Windows Hello or your keyring's password. Agents never see the PIN.
- Free and open source under the Apache-2.0 license, with no account to create.
week.trDesc: 让人工智能代理与您一起使用您的手机。
week.trFeat:
-小巧和原生。窗口由MyGo在GPU上绘制，没有Electron和webview ： 16–22 MB的下载，在Mac上以约70 MB的内存和0%的CPU空闲。
-任何代理，只需点击一下即可。 设置›代理连接Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Codex、Cursor等，任何可以使用MCP服务器的代理都可以在同一台计算机上或通过HTTP工作。
-手机锁定？从电脑上解锁。 将手机的PIN码保存在Pinky中一次，然后使用Touch ID、Windows Hello或您的钥匙圈密码确认每次解锁。 客服代表永远不会看到PIN码。
- Apache-2.0许可证下的免费和开源，无需创建帐户。

week.desc: Ocarina of Time running natively on Windows, no emulator. Built on your PC from your own copy. No game files included.
features: 1. Baixe o Ocarina-Setup-...-windows.zip da página de versões.
2. Extraia o ZIP inteiro para uma pasta e abra o Instalar-Ocarina.exe que está dentro dela.
3. O executável não tem assinatura digital, então o Windows pode avisar. Clique em Mais informações e depois em Executar assim mesmo.
4. Na janela, escolha o .nup do seu jogo (ou uma pasta com exefs e romfs) e clique em Instalar.
5. No fim, clique em Jogar, ou use o atalho Ocarina Recomp na Área de Trabalho.
1. O verificar.ps1 só olha e diz o que falta. Ele não altera nada.
2. O compilar.ps1 -Simular mostra todos os comandos sem executar nenhum.
3. O compilar.ps1 executa esses comandos, mostra cada um e pergunta antes de cada etapa. Se parar, rode de novo: ele continua de onde parou.
